description: Search this company's records the way the dashboard search bar does: products (name, SKU, GTIN, NDC), lots, units (chip ID, serial), tags (UID, EPC), shipments (reference, carrier, places), holds and cases, partners (name, GLN), locations, recalls, integrations and webhooks by name, plus Aeroz help topics. Paste an identifier as-is — a GTIN, NDC, GLN, lot, chip ID, GS1 Digital Link, element string or EPC URN is parsed and exact matches come first (`match: identifier`). Each area needs its own read scope; areas this key cannot read are listed in `skipped` — say so rather than reading an empty group as "none". Each hit has `href`, the dashboard screen it opens. To answer a question, use ask_agent.
